mapper.select: SELECT gr.room_id AS room_id, gr.title AS title, host.user_name AS host_name, COUNT(rm.user_id) AS current_players, gr.max_players AS max_players, gr.status AS status, CASE WHEN gr.room_password IS NOT NULL AND gr.room_password != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS locked FROM game_room gr JOIN `user` host ON host.user_id = gr.host_user_id LEFT JOIN room_members rm ON rm.room_id = gr.room_id GROUP BY gr.room_id, gr.title, host.user_name, gr.max_players, gr.status, gr.room_password, gr.created_time ORDER BY CASE WHEN gr.status = 'WAITING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, gr.created_time DESC
